page.overview:
Who is Abner Doolittle?

Unfortunately, the area was over-run by deadly fire-breathing monsters. Doolittle brainwashed the Falcon into combatting these monsters for him and opened another portal to Earth, in the hope of being able to get rid of the monsters by sending them there. Instead, Captain America and Texas Jack Muldoon used this portal to transport to Zero Street and free the Falcon. When the monsters invaded the asylum, Captain America forced everyone through the portal back to Earth and used a mechanism to destroy it before the monsters could follow them. With the rest of the Night People, he was then institutionalized in a SHIELD psychiatric ward.

Somehow later he came into service of Roxxon's Nth Command. He created the Nth Projector, a portable unit able to transport matter into other realities. Roxxon offered to assist Thundra in returning to her world. But she trusted no one, and she used the Projector to transport Doolittle and his associates to Femizonia so that they could not stop her from stealing the device.
